About the role The Silicon team are responsible for designing the silicon chips produced by Graphcore in leading node technologies and using the leading EDA Tools. Silicon is divided into three areas, that all work closely together: The Logical design and DFT team ; responsible for realising architectural intent in a form that can be physically implemented and subsequently manufacturing level tested. In this team you’ll be iterating with Architectural, Verification, Physical & Operations teams to define the microarchitecture and produce testable RTL as above. The Verification team ; ensure that our chips perform in accordance with their specification and that their implementation is similarly accurate. You’ll learn modern CPU and ASIC verification methodologies such as constrained random test generation and functional coverage and use those skills to verify our chips meet their specification. The Physical Design team ; take the logical RTL and produce final transistor level layout (GDS) ready to send to a foundry for manufacture. You will gain experience with modern physical implementation steps including, but not limited to, synthesis, place and route, timing analysis, physical design checks, power integrity, logical equivalence. Our designs are in leading edge technology nodes which bring a lot of interesting challenges to solve, a very good environment to learn the latest silicon design techniques. All 3 roles involve using industry standard EDA tools which you will become familiar with. About you We are looking for technical, passionate, and motivated individuals with a desire to learn, work and develop in a technically challenging, fast paced environment. A highly motivated, curious, self-starter, willing to take action, as proven through extra-curricular activities or hobbies beyond your studies Strong team-working and excellent interpersonal skills Passionate with a keen interest to learn about the exciting new field of AI We are not looking for an instant expert but graduates with the hunger to learn, develop and contribute to Graphcore's future. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. biocom-calico-life-sciences:greenhouse:8.description: Who We Are: Calico (Calico Life Sciences LLC) is an Alphabet-founded research and development company whose mission is to harness advanced technologies and model systems to increase our understanding of the biology that controls human aging. Calico will use that knowledge to devise interventions that enable people to lead longer and healthier lives. Calico’s highly innovative technology labs, its commitment to curiosity-driven discovery science and, with academic and industry partners, its vibrant drug-development pipeline, together create an inspiring and exciting place to catalyze and enable medical breakthroughs. Position Description : Calico is seeking a machine learning scientist to join a research group investigating how genome sequence determines regulatory function and how dysregulation of these programs drives aging. We develop sequence-based deep learning models that predict gene expression, chromatin accessibility, and other functional readouts directly from DNA. We use these models to interpret human genetic variation, map causal regulatory mechanisms, and identify promising intervention points. This work builds on a sustained research program at the intersection of deep learning and regulatory genomics, including: Avsec, Ž. et al. Effective gene expression prediction from sequence by integrating long-range interactions. Nat Methods 18 , 1196–1203 (2021). Yuan, H. & Kelley, D. Predicting RNA-seq coverage from DNA sequence as a unifying model of gene regulation. Nature Genetics (2025). Additional research can be found here . xange-skello:lever:074b63b0-bbe5-42ae-b5.description: Skello is a European company with one mission: reinvent shifted work through a collaborative solution which enables teams to better anticipate, organize and communicate. In short, Skello is a workforce management solution for shift based workplaces that enables teams to tackle the hassle of complex scheduling. For managers, Skello optimizes work organization by helping them to make the best decisions in managing their staff costs. For employees, our tool facilitates easy and open communication and simplifies daily life. Skello’s ambition is to be the number one solution for shifted work teams in Europe. To achieve this, Skello raised a €40M Series B round of financing from expert funds in the field (Partech, Aglaé Ventures & XAnge) in order to bring ever more value to our clients through new features and to open up new markets, beyond our historic industries such as hospitality, retail and health. Context In a context of strong growth, Skello's Growth team aims to hyper-scale lead generation and B2B customer acquisition. As a GTM Engineer (Acquisition & Growth focus), you will be the technical mastermind behind our growth engine. Your mission is to build, scale, and optimize the technical infrastructure that drives pipeline growth, automates lead generation, and maximizes our conversion rates. You will bridge the gap between engineering, data, and growth marketing, turning aggressive acquisition strategies into robust, automated technical solutions that lower CAC and boost lead velocity. Missions As a GTM Engineer specialized in Acquisition, your objectives are as follows: Engine and automate lead generation pipelines: Build and maintain automated data scrapers, workflows, and API integrations with data enrichment tools to feed our CRM with highly qualified B2B leads at scale. Optimize tracking & attribution infrastructure: Implement and manage advanced tracking architectures (such as server-side GTM, Segment, or custom APIs) to ensure flawless data collection across our ads channels (Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) and solve complex multi-touch attribution challenges. Scale GEO & SEO conversion: Develop and orchestrate scalable frameworks for landing pages, dynamic content personalization, and interactive web tools designed to turn mentions and traffic into active marketing qualified leads. Deploy technical conversion optimization (CRO): Partner with Growth Marketers and Designers to engineer advanced, glitch-free A/B testing scenarios and server-side experiments to continuously push conversion rates to their maximum. Build smart routing and lead scoring loops: Design and deploy automated routing and real-time lead scoring algorithms using intent data, ensuring the hottest acquisition leads are pushed instantly to the Sales team. What this position can offer you: The opportunity to play a highly strategic role by building the technical backbone of Skello's revenue engine; The opportunity to contribute in a concrete way to an ambitious project that will revolutionize a very large market through technical innovation; Ownership and autonomy over a modern tech stack (Data, CRM, APIs, AI) that will allow you to learn a lot and build scalable systems you can be proud of; A stimulating, challenging, and caring work environment at the exact intersection of Engineering and Business.
